Tender Notice – 15
Friday, 25 November 2016
6845 Hits
The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items. The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of “The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by 12/12/2016 up to 1.00 PM. The Technical Bids will be open on the next day i.e. 13/12/2016 at 3.00 pm in the Committee Room, Dean Office. The tender fees of Rs. 1,000/- (nonrefundable) is to be paid by Cash or by enclosing D.D. favoring ‘Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram’ payable at Sevagram / Wardha.
Tender forms will be available in the office of the Dean (Central Purchase Section) on working days between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm. Tender forms also can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Dean reserves the right to reject a ny or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Radiotherapy Department:
Breast Board for Radiotherapy Treatment
Microbiology Department:
-800C Deep Freezer
Autoclave
HIS Department:
Establishment of Annual Rate Contract for refilling of LaserJet printer Cartridges
Surgery Department:
Ultrasonic Tissue Dissection Device, 2) Laparoscopic Surgery Instruments, 3) General Surgery Instruments
Medicine Department:
Ventilator - 3 Units
Paediatrics Department:
Ventilator (Neonatal cum Infant mode) - 2 Units
